units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 1:3">Sabb. I, 3</cite> <he>הח׳ רואה וכ׳</he> on Friday night the governor may look in where the children read, but must not read himself.

senses.gloss: (in collegiate debates) one who announces the order of proceedings, crier, janitor &c.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 4:1:33">Y. Ber. IV, 7ᵈ</cite> top <he>אמרו לר׳ זינון הח׳ וכ׳</he> they said to R. Zinon the ḥazan, ‘Say, Commence’ (the debate)!

senses.gloss: (in synagogue) superintendent at prayer-meetings, giving the signals for responses, assigning seats &c., sexton.
units: <cite ref="Sukkah 51b:6">Succ. 51ᵇ</cite> <he>וח׳ הכנסת וכ׳</he> and the sexton stood upon it with the flag in his hand.
<cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 7:1">Yoma VII, 1</cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 7:8">Sot. VII, 8</cite>.

senses.gloss: (in court) crier, sheriff (collecting the votes, executing punishment).
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 7:4:6">Y. Sot. VII, 21ᵈ</cite> top.—Pl. <he>חַזָּנִים</he>, (<cite ref="H00552"><he>חֲזָ׳</he></cite>) <he>חַזָּנִין</he>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Sanhedrin 9:1">Tosef. Snh. IX, 1</cite> <he>הח׳ קורין וכ׳</he> the criers call out each judge’s name (to take his vote); Y. ib. V, end, 23ᵃ <he>חַזָּנֵי כנסיות</he>.
<cite ref="Makkot 23a:10">Macc. 23ᵃ</cite> <he>אין מעמידין ח׳ וכ׳</he> we must appoint as constables (for punishing) men of lesser physical strength &c.
